scope: Research evidence, not runtime catalog or implemented adapters

records.claim: Official announcement schedules API-key enforcement for direct edge.forgecdn.net downloads from July 16, 2026, with HTTP 401 for missing/invalid keys. x-api-key header is preferred to query parameters because URLs can leak through logs/history.
records.implication: Treat authentication failure separately from removed files and retain last-good metadata; never synthesize alternate CDN URLs to bypass restrictions.
records.verification_gap: Announcement reviewed, enforcement not live-tested; no key obtained or transmitted.

records.claim: Documentation describes per-IP 300 requests/minute, response limit/remaining/reset headers, uniquely identifying User-Agent, stable IDs rather than mutable slugs, and SHA-1/SHA-512 file identities. PAT/OAuth scopes restrict authenticated operations.
records.implication: Persist source IDs separately from display slugs; throttle according to current response headers rather than a permanent hardcoded quota. Preserve file hashes and distinguish rate-limit and scope errors.
records.verification_gap: Documentation reviewed; authenticated requests, quota behavior, and current installed adapter not live-tested.

records.claim: Portable Windows/Linux data lives inside the PrismLauncher folder; ordinary installations use OS data directories. Launcher-managed Java, cache, logs, instances, assets and metadata are separate internal folders.
records.implication: Portable acceptance must cover every owned data class, not only executable and saves. External runtimes or user-selected paths need explicit treatment.
records.verification_gap: Documentation reviewed; actual process writes and relocation not tested.

records.claim: Portable library defaults to application-relative library; portable config.json is beside the application. Installed defaults use AppData. Documentation warns against combining library folders from different instances, and notes plugin-dependent account handling.
records.implication: Use explicit non-destructive destination preflight and separate credential portability from library portability. Do not merge two stores by copying files over each other.
records.verification_gap: Documentation reviewed; copy/restore, plugin credentials, and filesystem effects not tested.
